axes_source: Read from data/brands/miro.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #1C1C1E and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #1C1C1E on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #1C1C1E; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 28, 32px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #1C1C1E reaches 17.01:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: Miro
